payload.core_mechanism_summary: Memoized recursive DP: precompute optimal points for erasing equal-character blocks of each length, then recursively consider erasing first block or merging equal characters by erasing middle part.
payload.rationale: Solution uses @lru_cache for recursion, precomputes dp for single-block removals, and explores choices via recursion on substrings. Perfect match for dp_memoized_recursion.
